handoff.name: I-PASS
handoff.intro: Write the OR-to-PACU handoff for a robotic-assisted joint replacement using I-PASS. Terse and factual; no invented vitals. Note any equipment/robot issues and whether they were resolved.

sections.label: P — Patient summary
sections.guidance: joint replaced, side, robotic system used, components implanted (femoral / tibial / patellar), cement vs cementless, tourniquet time if known, EBL, counts, phase reached, any intraoperative equipment issues and their resolution

sections.label: A — Action list
sections.guidance: weight-bearing status, DVT prophylaxis, drain if any, imaging to review

sections.label: S — Situation awareness & contingencies
sections.guidance: watch for neurovascular status, bleeding, pain — as if/then

sections.label: S — Synthesis by receiver
sections.guidance: leave a blank line labelled 'Receiver read-back:'

family.closing_line: The surgeon will come speak with you directly.
family.notes: A robot-assisted knee replacement — the surgeon guides a robotic arm to place the new joint precisely. Say the new joint parts are in place and the patient goes to recovery, then usually starts walking with physiotherapy the same or next day.
